_provenance: CropAtlas crop requirements. Every requirement value below is carried over UNCHANGED from the existing, source-cited repository reference `agronomy/crop_reference.json` (dataset saarthi-crop-reference v1.0.0, sources PAU Package of Practices Kharif/Rabi + ICAR-IARI). CropAtlas does not introduce new agronomic numbers. Dimensions the consulted reference does not state are recorded explicitly as unavailable so the engine can report 'Insufficient data' instead of inventing a value. See `not_available_dimensions`.

not_available_dimensions.temperature_range_c: The consulted PAU/ICAR package-of-practices reference in this repository does not state a per-crop optimum temperature range. CropAtlas therefore does not score crop temperature compatibility and never substitutes a guessed range.
not_available_dimensions.soil_ph_range: No per-crop soil pH range is stated in the repository reference. Soil pH is measured and displayed as environmental context only; it is never scored against a crop.
not_available_dimensions.soil_texture_class: No per-crop preferred soil texture class is stated in the repository reference. Soil texture is measured and displayed as environmental context only; it is never scored against a crop.
not_available_dimensions.season_rainfall_mm: No per-crop minimum seasonal rainfall requirement is stated in the repository reference. Growing-window rainfall is displayed as measured/reference context and compared only ordinally against the crop's own water_need_class.
not_available_dimensions.cec_requirement: No per-crop CEC requirement is stated in the repository reference.
not_available_dimensions.quantitative_irrigation_mm: No per-crop quantitative irrigation requirement (mm) is stated in the repository reference. Water requirement is presented only as the relative class recorded in the reference (water_need_class) plus the reference's own irrigation_rule_hint text.

water_need_ordinal._note: Ordinal ranking of the reference's qualitative water_need_class. It carries no mm value and is used only to compare a crop's demand class with an observed block water-balance class.

tolerance_ordinal._note: Ordinal ranking of the reference's qualitative tolerance/sensitivity classes.

crops.duration_basis: short-duration representative (PR-126); Pusa-44 is longer (~145 d)
crops.irrigation_rule_hint: Puddled transplanted rice; keep 2-5 cm standing water through tillering. A drained or dry surface warrants a watch during panicle initiation and flowering.

crops.duration_basis: early-duration representative (PB-1509); PB-1121 is longer (~140 d)
crops.irrigation_rule_hint: Aromatic quality and grain elongation depend on avoiding moisture stress at flowering.

crops.duration_basis: Bt hybrid representative to last picking
crops.irrigation_rule_hint: Far more tolerant of dry surface soil than rice; excessive rain or waterlogging at squaring-boll stage is the bigger risk.
Tasseling-silking is the most moisture-critical window; waterlogging at seedling stage also needs a watch.

crops.duration_basis: timely-sown representative (HD-2967); PBW-725 is slightly longer (~145 d)
crops.irrigation_rule_hint: Four scheduled irrigations (crown root, tillering, jointing, flowering); a dry ET0-heavy stretch near a scheduled irrigation moves the advisory.
Grand growth is the peak water-demand phase; ET0-driven irrigation guidance matters most there.
